description: This is a sample feature list for MyProject.

features.name: note_search
features.title: Implement Note Search Filter
features.description: Allow users to filter the list of notes dynamically through a search input fields matching text against title or body.
acceptance: The system should display a text input field for typing the search query.
The notes list should update dynamically in-memory as the user types without full page reloads.
The filter must be case-insensitive and scan both the note title and body fields.
If no results match the query, a clean fallback UI state showing 'No results found' must be rendered.
The search logic and UI components must be fully covered by automated tests.
